req.title: Reject limit above cap
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when the limit parameter exceeds the maximum allowed.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states the system must return HTTP 422 when the limit parameter exceeds the maximum allowed value. From the source, the maximum allowed limit is 1000 (le=1000 in the Query definition). Tests must cover: (1) a positive case with a valid limit well within range, (2) a negative case with limit clearly above 1000, (3) boundary cases at exactly 1000 (valid), 1001 (invalid), and 999 (valid). This ensures mutations to the constant 1000, the comparison operator (le vs lt), and the status code (422 vs others) are all caught.

tests.name: test_limit_valid_midrange_returns_200
expected: Response body is a JSON list
List contains exactly 20 items (all rows in DB)
trace: R-TASK-007: valid limit within [1, 1000] must succeed
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_limit_valid_midrange_returns_200():
    r = client.get('/tasks/?limit=100')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body, list)
    assert len(body) == 20

test_limit_valid_midrange_returns_200()
